name: toss
description: Send files to your own devices and friends, peer to peer and end-to-end encrypted.
long_description:
toss sends files straight between devices: no accounts, no cloud storage, end-to-end encrypted with a post-quantum key exchange. With this extension Claude can list your paired devices, send them files, put files on your phone and see what arrived lately, and nothing else: pairing, removing devices and settings stay with you. toss itself asks you, in a window of its own, before anything leaves from outside the folders you pick here, and before any file that looks like a secret.

Pair your devices first with the toss app ([download](https://github.com/plamen-g/toss/releases)). Someone on the other device still accepts each transfer, unless it takes files from yours without asking.

folders.title: Folders Claude may send from without asking
